decisions.choice: Rotate one credential per day, not all at once.
decisions.rationale: A simultaneous rotation last year took down staging for six hours.

retained_constraints.statement: The billing worker's credential is rotated last; it has no retry and a failed rotation drops invoices.
Every rotation is recorded in ticket OPS-233 before the next one starts.
Prefer the vault CLI over the web console so the action is scriptable.

summary.text: Seven service credentials need rotating before the 1 September audit. One per day, billing worker last. Log each rotation in OPS-233 before starting the next. The legacy reporting credential has no known owner and is blocking.

task.title: Rotate the service credentials before the audit

unresolved.statement: Nobody knows who owns the legacy reporting credential.
